description: Round: the Eagan Matrix rounding controls — how fast a note slides to its rounded pitch, which scale it rounds to, and when rounding applies

params.text: Sets how fast a note moves to its rounded pitch, 0 to 127, from no rounding through slow to very fast
Turns initial rounding on and off
Chooses when rounding applies, marked Normal, Release, Y and inverse Y; right-click it to pick from a menu
Picks the tuning scale that notes are rounded to, 12-tone equal temperament by default; right-click it to pick from a menu
Switches the rate knob between absolute and relative control voltage: absolute makes a patched cable set the rate on its own, relative adds the cable to the knob

inputs.text: Sets the rounding rate from a cable, 0V to 10V on its own or added to the knob when the relative button is on
Turns initial rounding on or off on a trigger

notes: this module does nothing on its own: it needs an HC-1 in the patch, which it finds by itself, so it can be placed anywhere in the rack rather than beside it
the lights along the top show the rounding state the Continuum shows in the corner of its own display

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the knob beside it.
inputs.1:
high above 5V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
